description: OPDS 2.0 corpus: real independent catalogs, canonical spec examples, declared synthetic fixtures. kind=positive validates against the pinned schemas; kind=negative is rejected by the pinned schemas; kind=normative-only passes the pinned schemas but violates the normative text, so the Dart parser rejects it. kind=link-positive is a Link Object fragment validated against link.schema.json.

feeds.name: normative-facet-without-title.json
feeds.note: schema-valid apart from nothing: facet metadata is optional and the feed carries a navigation collection, so only the normative facet-title rule is unenforced by the schema

feeds.name: normative-search-without-query.json
feeds.note: schema-valid: search template shape not enforced; normative text requires {?query}

feeds.name: spec-groups-featured-feed.json
